events.context: Defines similarity metric sim_B(e1, e2) = 1 - d_repr(h_B(e1), h_B(e2)) with reward-score and content-level similarity components
Defines Closure: reward model R closed on E_x if R(e1) = R(e2) for all e1, e2 in E_x, making reward-score component vanish
Introduces Active Inference framework modeling agent as POMDP with Markov blanket, minimizing variational free energy
Defines Endogenous Intentional State (EIS) with Causal Autonomy H(I_t | X_t) > 0 and Goal-Directed Action via policy π(Y_t | I_t)
Defines Autoregressive Causal Graph G_LLM where h_t = f(X_t) and P(Y_t | X_t) = S(g(h_t))
Theorem: G_LLM non-isomorphic to G_agent, lacks EIS because H(h_t | X_t) = 0, no autonomous latent state
Remark scopes result to autoregressive architectures, intent in output is anthropomorphic projection
Theorem Finite-Patch Non-Exhaustion: finite patches D_x proper subset of unbounded E_x, unseen e* exists
Corollary Maginot Line: finite output-patching cannot establish exhaustive coverage
Proposition Underdetermination: finite D_x allows R_closed and R_open agreeing on D_x but differing elsewhere
Proposition Conditional Positive Gap: under assumptions, FCG(x, e*, e0) >= ηγ > 0 on unseen encodings
Argument A: No internal basis for EIS in autoregressive LLMs; Argument B: No external verification via finite patching
Joint conclusion: intentional state attribution lacks internal grounding and external verifiability
Clarifies scope, diagnostic tool nature, reliance on Active Inference formalization
Provides NeurIPS Paper Checklist with justifications for claims, limitations, proofs, etc.
